pages.text: Every machine can run $(l)in reverse$(): it consumes a region block by block and banks $(l)Filament Units$() into its docked spools.$(br2)Set $(l)two corners$() with the $(item)Structure Scanner$(), then $(o)sneak-click the machine$(). The region cannot exceed the machine's footprint, or 64 blocks away.

pages.title: Lossy By Design
pages.text: Deconstructing credits a $(l)fraction$() of each block's value ($(o)yieldFactor$(), default $(l)50%$()), always less than winding it yourself, so there is no free loop.$(li)Blacklisted blocks recycle at $(l)zero$()$(li)Free structural blocks clear for free$(li)$(l)Unvalued$() blocks and full containers are skipped in place

pages.title: Running a Job
pages.text: Toggle $(l)Print / Decon$() in the GUI. With no armed region it reads $(l)No Region Set$(). The region shows as a $(c:red)red wireframe$().$(br2)The $(l)first$() job after arming always needs $(l)Start$(): Auto never fires on a fresh region, so nothing dissolves by surprise.$(br2)Jobs work top-down and pause $(l)before$() a block whose filament has nowhere to go. Filament is never voided.

pages.title: Which Mode Am I In?
pages.text: The $(l)Print / Decon$() button names the mode you are $(o)in$(), not the one it switches to, which is easy to read backwards.$(br2)So the $(l)Auto$() button only exists in Print mode. $(l)See Auto, you are printing. No Auto, you are deconstructing.$()

pages.title: Un-printing
pages.text: Printed something you did not want? Flip to $(l)Decon$(). With no region of its own it arms an $(l)un-print$() of the last build; press $(l)Start$() and it dissolves.$(br2)An un-print is $(l)masked$(): only blocks the print actually laid down, still unchanged, are taken. Anything you added is left alone.$(br2)It is one-shot. The machine disarms when it finishes.

pages.title: Wind-Only Isn't Safe
pages.text: Skipping keys off $(l)FU value alone$(). Wind-only treasure like the $(item)Dragon Egg$() $(o)is$() valued, it just never prints back, so it is $(l)not$() skipped: one inside an armed region is consumed like any other block, crediting half its winding value.$(br2)Move anything you care about outside the region before you press Start.
